Alex.name: Alex
Alex.background: College student who recently moved away from home for the first time.
Alex.current_struggle: Feeling overwhelmed by academic expectations and pressure from family to succeed.
Alex.communication_style: Talks quickly when anxious, sometimes changes topics, and is hesitant to admit when he is struggling.

Maya.name: Maya
Maya.background: Single mother working remotely while caring for two children.
Maya.current_struggle: Feeling emotionally drained and disconnected from activities she used to enjoy.
Maya.communication_style: Quiet and thoughtful, gives short answers at first, and has difficulty talking about her own needs.

Matt.name: Matt
Matt.background: Software engineer who recently received a promotion and relocated to a new city.
Matt.current_struggle: Experiencing work-related burnout and difficulty adjusting to his new environment.
Matt.communication_style: Polite and analytical, tends to intellectualize his emotions and initially focuses on facts rather than feelings.

Sofia.name: Sofia
Sofia.background: Retired teacher whose adult children live in different states.
Sofia.current_struggle: Feeling lonely after retirement and struggling with changes in her family relationships.
Sofia.communication_style: Warm and talkative but sometimes minimizes her own emotions and quickly changes the subject when discussing loneliness.
